summary_en: Capital cost and share price-conscious management framework updated. Board reviewed current progress against June 2024 initial COC targets and revised improvement policies and specific initiatives effective June 17, 2026. Detailed metrics and revised targets in attached document.
title_en: Response toward realization of management conscious of capital cost and share price
translation_en_brief: Nissan Securities Group disclosed an update to its capital cost and share price-conscious management framework on June 17, 2026. The company had first announced this framework in June 2024. In this update, the board reviewed the company's current performance against the initial COC targets, analyzed progress, and approved revised improvement policies and specific implementation measures. The full details of the updated framework, including revised metrics and targets, are contained in the attached supplementary document dated June 2026.
